labels.why: "Clicking an option selects it (only one at a time...)" and "shows `Confirmed: <name>`"; keeping selection and status on the element only decides where that state lives, and it adds no store.

labels.why: Option names come from the `options` attribute and must render as the given names; parsing them as markup would show the wrong content and could inject elements.

labels.why: "marked with aria-pressed"; aria-disabled for the unchoosable option and role=status for the status line are accessibility rigour on the requested controls.
